title: P0 live-check plan package: four independent final reviews (issues, issues, issues, pass)
baseline_kind: original recorded run (DECISIONS.md D3); no new run was made

metric_definitions.round: round k = review k plus the fix cycle that followed it; 'after round k' is the state at the start of review k+1; 'after round 4' is the final archived package
metric_definitions.blocking: a finding the reviewer graded blocking under the severity test it was given (refs/qa.md 'Severity model' and 'FINAL derived test'; the four checklist answers amiss/false/harm/constraint, any 'yes' = blocking). Counts are the reviewers' own gradings; the analyst did not re-grade them.

provenance_legend.READ: taken from a statement in the log or reviewer report
provenance_legend.COUNTED: counted by the analyst from log records with a script (derivation-scripts/)
provenance_legend.RE-DERIVED: worked out by the analyst from rebuilt document states and timestamps, not stated by the reviewer

M4_document_size.growth_note: Growth is tiny and mostly fixed by the owner rulings and disclosure notes (the whole loop adds 4,551 bytes: about 2.5 KB to the ledger, 0.9 KB to the phase report, the rest to the lc2 and lc3 step files), not by review churn. Criterion (b) of DECISIONS.md D6 (re-run growth <= 70 percent of baseline) means <= 0.415 percent (package) or <= 0.515 percent (delivery files) here.

d6_implications.criterion_a: The baseline's last round has 0 blocking findings, so 'last-round blocking <= 50 percent of baseline' cannot be improved on. Only the second branch applies: a clean pass in fewer rounds than baseline, i.e. FINAL: pass at review 1, 2 or 3.
d6_implications.criterion_c: Both replicates will differ from the baseline by ordinary run-to-run variation: the reviewers are fresh model sessions that pick their own checks (round 1's reviewer happened to find a count slip, round 3's reviewer created its own process finding). Two replicates that disagree by a round or more make any 1-round improvement 'not significant' under D6(c).
d6_implications.reach_of_pr_427: This scenario's reviewer is the /sc:implement managed final review, not /sc:spec-panel. PR 427 changed no file under src/superclaude/skills/sc-implement-protocol or commands/implement.md (checked: git show --name-only 95f2c6e4). Expected delta from 427 is zero; a measured delta is run-to-run noise. S5 is useful as a negative control.

not_recoverable: The executor's reasoning and the exact wording of its fixes beyond the logged Edit inputs (the Edit inputs themselves are verbatim).
Original file permission bits of the package files (so the original package digests cannot be reproduced).

The original checkout's live git state (HEAD 8db29f11 with a staged .dev/tasks, other sessions' packages staged, protected-folder mtimes): reviewers checked these live; a replay cannot reproduce them exactly.
Reviewer sampling randomness: nothing in the logs can make a fresh reviewer pick the same checks.
